description: Header file defining the QhullUser class, which provides custom C++ interfaces into the Qhull library, including data capture and access methods.

classes.name: QhullUser
classes.description: A class providing custom C++ interfaces into Qhull, managing data capture, access, and configuration related to Qhull computations.

methods.name: QhullUser
methods.description: Constructor initializing QhullUser with a QhullQh pointer.

methods.name: appendCode
methods.description: Appends a message code to the internal codes vector.

methods.name: appendDouble
methods.description: Appends a double value to the internal doubles vector.

methods.name: appendInt
methods.description: Appends an integer to the internal integers vector.

methods.name: appendAndClearDoubles
methods.description: Stores current doubles vector into doubles_vector and clears it.

methods.name: appendAndClearInts
methods.description: Stores current integers vector into ints_vector and clears it.

methods.name: codes
methods.description: Returns the vector of message codes.

methods.name: doublesVector
methods.description: Returns the vector of doubles vectors.

methods.name: doubles
methods.description: Returns the vector of captured doubles.

methods.name: firstCode
methods.description: Returns the first message code or -1 if none.

methods.name: ints
methods.description: Returns the vector of captured integers.

methods.name: intsVector
methods.description: Returns the vector of integer vectors.

methods.name: numDoubles
methods.description: Returns the number of doubles vectors stored.

methods.name: numInts
methods.description: Returns the number of integer vectors stored.

methods.name: qh
methods.description: Returns the pointer to the associated QhullQh object.
